values.summary: Freeze the merged #317 packet, independently reconstruct all 13 canonical rows from retained raw authority, review v0.92.1/v0.92.2 readiness, run exact negative comparisons, resolve findings, and obtain exact-head review without remote ceremony mutation.

steps.action: Confirm #317 reviewed-green merge ancestry and independently reconstruct the live-checked normalized #307-#319 issue universe.
Review v0.92.1 and v0.92.2 handoff truth without creating issues or activating a successor milestone.
Audit and correct the canonical v0.92.1 planning package so exact tail identity, dependency order, source provenance, and all 45 structured single-unit issue contracts hold.
Run the focused validator and ten exact negative fixtures, disposition findings, and obtain independent exact-head review.

invariants: The canonical denominator is exactly 13 unique current-repository issues.
Raw provenance digests are recomputed independently before comparison.
Only reviewed green merge ancestry gates successors; closeout remains asynchronous.
The ten v0.92.1 release-tail titles and serial order are exact canonical identity.
No successor milestone, especially v0.93, is activated.
risks: Reusing the #317 envelope could disguise a sliced or stale denominator.
Self-bound digests or generic negative failures could produce false confidence.
Planning language could accidentally create successor authority or serialize on closeout.
stop_conditions: #317 merge ancestry or exact reviewed identity cannot be reproduced.
The independent denominator is not exactly 13 unique canonical rows.
Raw provenance, digest, ownership, or disposition truth is incomplete or contradictory.
A negative case does not return its exact expected blocker.
An actionable finding remains or the work would activate a successor milestone.
